value.rationale: Guéant’s 2026 work identifies mixtures with >=3 components as a live boundary problem. This theorem exactly and quantitatively separates a necessary projected inequality from a natural computable sufficient certificate for every dimension, proves a dimension-dependent factor tending to sqrt(2), and determines unique endpoint correlations. It is a motivated structural boundary and all-dimensional classification in a canonical symmetric family, not an arbitrary finite recomputation. Scope limitations are explicit.
